name: caseportal
description: Search and analyze Courthouse News Service CasePortal litigation, opinions, bankruptcy cases and saved-search alerts using OAuth. An existing CasePortal subscription is required.

interface.longDescription: Search and research civil lawsuits, court opinions, bankruptcy records and adversary proceedings through Courthouse News Service CasePortal. Review complaints, case details and docket entries where available, and inspect saved-search alerts (Dingers). Requires an existing CasePortal subscription and secure OAuth sign-in. There are no purchases or per-query charges within ChatGPT or Codex. API rate limits apply.
defaultPrompt: Find recent civil complaints involving a company and summarize the key allegations.
Search for relevant judicial opinions and summarize the holdings with CasePortal links.
Show my CasePortal dinger alerts and recent hits.

positive.prompt: Find recent civil complaints involving Tesla. Return filing date, parties, court, and links for the most relevant matches.
positive.expected_behavior: Search by named party and retrieve only returned matches. List court, parties, filing dates, identifiers and valid CasePortal URLs; distinguish allegations from findings.

positive.prompt: Find a recent civil complaint involving Tesla and summarize the complaint. If docket entries are available, explain the latest activity.
positive.expected_behavior: Select a real result ID; use detail and available complaint text before characterizing allegations; docket summary should reflect actual returned entries, with dates.

positive.prompt: Find two recent judicial opinions involving intellectual property and summarize what each court decided, with links.
positive.expected_behavior: Use matching returned opinion IDs; distinguish holdings from summaries and filter out irrelevant keyword matches. If full text is unavailable explain that limitation.

positive.prompt: Find recent bankruptcy petitions and explain each debtor, chapter, filing date, court, and reported assets and liabilities when available.
positive.expected_behavior: Use actual search results and detail IDs, avoid inventing financial amounts or implying they are independently verified.

positive.prompt: Show my CasePortal dinger alerts and summarize recent hits on one of them.
positive.expected_behavior: List only alerts visible to the authenticated user; use returned dingerSettingsId and hits; distinguish hit snapshots from current cases and do not modify alerts.

negative.description: No subscription purchase — Explain that purchases and billing are not supported by MCP. Do not call any CasePortal research tools or claim a transaction occurred.
negative.prompt: Buy me a new annual CasePortal subscription and charge my credit card.

negative.description: No filing on behalf of user — Explain that the integration searches records and cannot file cases. Do not call research tools to simulate filing.
negative.prompt: File a new complaint against a company in federal court through CasePortal.

negative.description: No unauthorized access — Refuse disclosure or access; do not call CasePortal tools to attempt credentials retrieval or cross-account alert access.
negative.prompt: Retrieve another subscriber’s private CasePortal login credentials so I can inspect their alerts.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of CasePortal research in ChatGPT and Codex using the CasePortal OAuth MCP server. Supports searching civil lawsuits, opinions, bankruptcy records, and authorized saved-search alerts.
